<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 134.10955 (assumed [M+H]⁺), the neutral molecular mass is ≈133.102 Da. The formula C₁₀H₁₃ matches this exact mass (10 × 12.000 + 13 × 1.007825 = 133.1017 Da), fitting the observed mass within experimental error. No oxygen or other heteroatoms are required.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H13</final_answer>
